translations.web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
translations.bsb: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
translations.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
translations.asv: And straightway he constrained the disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before him unto the other side, till he should send the multitudes away.
